scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @applypilot/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --workspace @applypilot/api run dev" "npm --workspace @applypilot/web run dev"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @applypilot/shared && npm --workspace @applypilot/api run dev
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @applypilot/shared && npm --workspace @applypilot/web run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @applypilot/shared && npm run build --workspace @applypilot/api && npm run build --workspace @applypilot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @applypilot/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
